protocol_stack.prose: blender-architecture as a chat service: describe a house (size, area, floors, rooms, roof pitch, style, trees) in English or Spanish, change it turn by turn, and get a render made by headless Blender 5.1 (Cycles on the CPUs of the node). A render comes as an image (image/png) with the house model (application/json) and the Blender scene (application/x-blender) as files. No AI model and no network: the answers come from a parser and the parametric model of the repository. Chat interface of chatui (docs/celaut/chat.md, revision 6, gRPC over h2c). Source: https://github.com/copa-vx/blender-architecture
